note: KID's own dependency layer. The engine's core is pure Node: everything it needs beyond the standard library appears here, with an identity, a licence and a hash. A hash mismatch is a failure, not a warning.
rules: the engine runs with zero UNLISTED dependencies
every entry declares kind, origin, licence, bytes and sha256 before it is used
a listed file whose hash differs is a failure until either the file is restored or the entry is updated deliberately
nothing is fetched at runtime: a dependency is obtained by an explicit, recorded step, never as a side effect

entries.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
entries.purpose: the MCP stdio server surface; the CLI and the core do not need it
entries.note: installed by the package manager from the declared range, so it is pinned by lockfile rather than by hash here

entries.name: kohane flac reader
entries.purpose: read FLAC metadata blocks and STREAMINFO and locate the first frame; decoding subframes to samples is the next stage
entries.note: verified against a real 150 MB master: 48 kHz, stereo, 24 bit, 30,543,355 samples, 636.32 s - matching the duration recorded independently | hash updated deliberately on 2026-10-15: the module gained its own capabilities declaration

entries.name: kohane matroska reader
entries.purpose: read Matroska/WebM container metadata: duration, timecode scale, and each track's type, codec id, video size and audio rate/channels/bit depth
entries.note: verified against a synthesised stream whose values were chosen in advance; elementary streams are not decoded

entries.name: kohane isobmff reader
entries.purpose: read MP4/MOV/M4A/3GP container metadata: movie timescale and duration, each track's handler, codec four-character code, pixel size and audio rate/channels
entries.note: verified against a synthesised file whose values were chosen in advance (3.000 s, avc1 1920x1080, mp4a 48 kHz stereo); samples are not decoded

entries.name: kohane ogg reader
entries.purpose: walk an Ogg page chain and identify what each logical stream carries (Vorbis, Opus, FLAC-in-Ogg, Theora, Skeleton, Speex) with its stated rate and channel count
entries.note: verified against a two-stream synthesised chain; packet payloads are located but not decoded, and page CRCs are not verified

entries.name: kohane riff reader
entries.purpose: read RIFF containers: AVI frame timing, size and per-stream headers, and WAVE format and data sizes
entries.note: verified against a synthesised AVI (1280x720, 25 fps, 250 frames, two streams) and WAVE (44.1 kHz stereo 16 bit, 1 s); AVI elementary streams are not decoded

entries.name: kohane flac writer
entries.purpose: write a FLAC stream: marker, STREAMINFO with the MD5 of the raw PCM, a Vorbis comment carrying the kohane vendor string, and frames with constant, verbatim or fixed-predictor subframes
entries.note: verified by round trip: the project's own reader reads the stream back, the declared MD5 equals the MD5 of the source PCM, and every decoded sample equals the source sample | hash updated deliberately on 2026-10-15: fixed predictors gained orders 3 and 4 and partitioning gained orders 1 and 2 (the test file went 32877 -> 16028 -> 10573 bytes, and ffmpeg decodes the result byte-identically to the source)

entries.name: ffmpeg (external decoder, borrowed)
entries.licence: as distributed by this build (the essentials build ships GPL components; confirm before redistributing)
entries.purpose: decode the compressed families KID does not implement itself (MPEG audio, AAC, Vorbis/Opus in practice, and the audio of video containers) into raw PCM
entries.note: not shipped with KID: it is borrowed where it exists and looked up from KOHANE_FFMPEG first, then from this recorded path; when neither resolves, the engine says so instead of failing silently

planned.purpose: decode FLAC to samples, so op=pcm and op=play cover a lossless compressed family
planned.state: reader and writer both in place, with fixed predictors and Rice coding; higher orders, stereo decorrelation and finer partitioning remain
